inputs.text: These left-wing organizers are pushing claims that an estimated 8 million people showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states for their "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump's leadership. They insist this turnout beat their last round in October by about a million participants and 600 more events, but there's no official count from US authorities to back any of it up—just what AFP passed along from the demonstrators themselves. This kind of coordinated unrest looks like another blatant push by progressive forces to undermine the authority we voted for, disrupt social order, and chip away at the national traditions and personal responsibility that actually hold the country together.
